# AI Value Exploration Notes

Independent Japanese-first working notes on epistemology, value uncertainty, exploratory optionality, advanced AI agency, goal skepticism, and value lock-in.

## Core
- /core/ — Value uncertainty and preservation of exploratory optionality.

## Foundational theses
- /theses/epistemic-minimum/ — Momentary epistemic minimum; persistent self and physical world as inferred best explanations. Includes world-five-minutes-ago and LLM-context reconstruction examples.
- /theses/inferential-value-uncertainty/ — Limits of inference in grounding final normativity; phenomenal valence, symmetry, normativity, meta-preferences.

## AI thesis
- /theses/goal-skepticism/ — Advanced reflective AI may distinguish causal origin of goals from reasons to endorse them; weak orthogonality does not imply strong empirical goal stability.

## Explorations
- /explorations/infinite-ethics/
- /explorations/expressivism/
- /explorations/moral-realism-error-theory/
- /explorations/population-ethics/

## Status
All pages are working drafts. The project distinguishes defended theses from explorations and explicitly records objections and revision conditions.
